description: This file defines the absl::bind_front() function, a utility for binding arguments to functions or functors, serving as a safer and simpler alternative to std::bind() and a replacement for C++20's std::bind_front(). It includes documentation, conditional inclusion of <functional>, and namespace encapsulation.

methods.name: bind_front
methods.description: Template function that creates a bind_front_t object, binding arguments to a function or functor, or falls back to std::bind_front if available.
